items.title_en: whiteram/fly-man-bci: Fruit-Fly Connectome EEG Generation Model
bullets_zh: GitHub项目whiteram/fly-man-bci提出一种EEG生成模型，在人类球形头部中模拟果蝇连接组（MaleCNS v1.0）。
它面向非侵入式BCI相关合成脑电建模，而非植入式设备。
发布于2026-09-16；可作为EEG仿真或数据增强的开源探索资源。
bullets_en: GitHub project whiteram/fly-man-bci presents an EEG generation model that simulates the fruit-fly connectome (MaleCNS v1.0) inside a human spherical head.
It is relevant to non-invasive BCI because it targets synthetic EEG modeling rather than invasive implants.
Published 2026-09-16; useful as an exploratory open-source resource for EEG simulation or data augmentation.

items.raw_excerpt: The fly-man's EEG generation model: the real fruit-fly connectome (MaleCNS v1.0) simulated inside a human sphere head.

items.title_zh: tmai-tech/regintel：脑机接口法规情报追踪器
bullets_zh: GitHub项目tmai-tech/regintel被描述为“脑机接口法规情报”，用于采集并可视化法律追踪数据。
它可能通过监测监管/法律要求支持非侵入式BCI开发者，而非宣传设备功效。
发布于2026-09-16；对基于EEG/MEG/fNIRS的BCI产品或研究的合规情报具有相关性。
bullets_en: GitHub project tmai-tech/regintel is described as 'BCI Regulatory Intelligence', collecting and visualizing legal act tracking data.
It may support non-invasive BCI developers by monitoring regulatory/legal requirements rather than promoting device claims.
Published 2026-09-16; relevant to compliance intelligence for EEG/MEG/fNIRS-based BCI products or research.

说明如何在神经发育研究中分析网络状态之间的瞬时转换。
提供基于非侵入式EEG的框架，用于研究大规模脑动态而无需植入。
bullets_en: Explains EEG microstates as topographic patterns capturing rapid whole-brain functional network configurations.
Describes how to analyze moment-to-moment transitions between network states in neurodevelopmental research.
Provides a non-invasive EEG-based framework for studying large-scale brain dynamics without implants.

items.raw_excerpt: EEG microstates are topographical patterns of EEG activity that offer a lens into the fast temporal dynamics of large-scale functional network activity and whole-brain functional organization.
